svg.text: UltraNova front panel — what every control sends in Automap mode
they change mode, and that is all
row 0 OSC1 OSC2 CUTOFF RES ATTACK DECAY SUSTAIN RELEASE
MOD wheel is B3 index 1, and
MASTER VOLUME and MONITOR are analogue — they reach the host as nothing at all.
Lamps 28–34 match these buttons. Above 34 the numbering parts company: code 35 is VALUE + when pressed,
and the second vocoder indicator when lit. Lamps 36–41 are the SELECT 1–6 markers, which have no buttons.
The three RATE lamps by the LFO run off the LFOs themselves and ignore the host.
Codes 12 and 14 exist as lamps but never as presses. Buttons and lamps share numbering only up to 34. Every value measured on hardware.
